At the end, you will have 90 seconds to explain the project aloud. The narration uses a local synthetic voice. The experiment records, not the voice or the AI discussion, are the evidence.

Start with three words. A packet is one small network message. A flow groups related packets into a conversation. An intrusion detection system, or IDS, observes traffic and raises alerts for investigation. A classifier assigns categories. It does not automatically supply packet capture, connection grouping, and alert policy or blocking. A GPU accelerates numerical operations. It does not fill in these missing system components.

The paper combines three views of the same flow. Bite content, packet sizes, and time gaps. Combining these views is what multimodal means here. Mamba processes a sequence by updating a numerical state. It is not a chatbot. The earlier NetMamba model used bytes alone. Our measured work exercises the multimodal NetMamba plus classifier on a GB10 graphics processor.

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def timestamp(value):
    hours, minutes, seconds = value.split(":")
    return Decimal(hours) * 3600 + Decimal(minutes) * 60 + Decimal(seconds)


def main():
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())
    scenes = manifest["scenes"]
    if len(scenes) != 60 or manifest["fps"] != 10:
        raise ValueError("Expected 60 scenes at 10 fps")
    original_identities = {
        str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(p)
        for p in [MEDIA, ASS, *[WORK / "frames" / (s["id"] + ".png") for s in scenes]]
    }
    events = []
    for line in ASS.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("Dialogue: "):
            fields = line.removeprefix("Dialogue: ").split(",", 9)
            events.append({"start": timestamp(fields[1]), "end": timestamp(fields[2]),
                           "style": fields[3], "text": fields[9]})
    samples = []
    for scene in scenes:
        midpoint = (Decimal(str(scene["start"])) + Decimal(str(scene["end"]))) / 2
        sample_time = (midpoint * 10).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING) / 10
        samples.append({"name": "scene-" + scene["id"], "kind": "scene_midpoint",
                        "scene": scene, "requested_time": midpoint, "frame_time": sample_time})
    for number, chapter in enumerate(manifest["chapters"], 1):
        sample_time = Decimal(str(chapter["start"])) + Decimal("0.2")
        scene = next(s for s in scenes if Decimal(str(s["start"])) <= sample_time < Decimal(str(s["end"])))
        samples.append({"name": f"chapter-{number:02d}-{chapter['id']}", "kind": "chapter_start_plus_0.2",
                        "scene": scene, "requested_time": sample_time, "frame_time": sample_time})

    def command_frame(command, log_path):
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
        log_path.write_text(result.stderr)
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Frame command exited {result.returncode}; see {log_path}")
        matches = re.findall(r"n:\s*0\s+pts:\s*\S+\s+pts_time:([0-9.]+)", result.stderr)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing or ambiguous first-frame PTS; see {log_path}")
        return Decimal(matches[0])

    def check(sample):
        name, scene, frame_time = sample["name"], sample["scene"], sample["frame_time"]
        actual = OUTPUT / (name + "-actual.png")
        expected = OUTPUT / (name + "-expected.png")
        source = WORK / "frames" / (scene["id"] + ".png")
        actual_log = OUTPUT / (name + "-actual.log")
        expected_log = OUTPUT / (name + "-expected.log")
        extract_command = [FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-nostats", "-loglevel", "info",
                           "-ss", str(frame_time), "-copyts", "-threads", "1", "-i", str(MEDIA),
                           "-map", "0:v:0", "-vf", "showinfo", "-frames:v", "1",
                           "-fps_mode", "passthrough", "-threads", "1", "-y", str(actual)]
        actual_time = command_frame(extract_command, actual_log)
        if actual_time != frame_time:
            raise ValueError(f"Actual timestamp drift in {name}: {actual_time} != {frame_time}")
        # Rounding the integral 10-Hz PTS prevents floating arithmetic truncation.
        overlay_command = [FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-nostats", "-loglevel", "info",
                           "-framerate", "10", "-i", str(source), "-vf",
                           f"setpts=PTS+round({actual_time}/TB),ass=runs/video-course/captions.ass,showinfo",
                           "-frames:v", "1", "-fps_mode", "passthrough", "-threads", "1", "-y", str(expected)]
        expected_time = command_frame(overlay_command, expected_log)
        if expected_time != actual_time:
            raise ValueError(f"Overlay timestamp drift in {name}: {expected_time} != {actual_time}")
        with Image.open(actual) as im:
            actual_image = im.convert("RGB")
        with Image.open(expected) as im:
            expected_image = im.convert("RGB")
        with Image.open(source) as im:
            source_image = im.convert("RGB")
        if {actual_image.size, expected_image.size, source_image.size} != {(1920, 1080)}:
            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected frame size in {name}")
        def mad(a, b, crop):
            delta = ImageChops.difference(a.crop(crop), b.crop(crop))
            return sum(ImageStat.Stat(delta).mean) / 3
        differences = {
            "upper_850px_vs_source": mad(actual_image, source_image, (0, 0, 1920, 850)),
            "bottom_230px_vs_overlay": mad(actual_image, expected_image, (0, 850, 1920, 1080)),
            "full_frame_vs_overlay": mad(actual_image, expected_image, (0, 0, 1920, 1080)),
        }
        return {
            "name": name, "kind": sample["kind"], "scene": scene["id"], "scene_kind": scene["kind"],
            "requested_time": str(sample["requested_time"]), "extracted_frame_timestamp": str(actual_time),
            "expected_overlay_timestamp": str(expected_time), "timestamps_equal": actual_time == expected_time,
            "mean_absolute_rgb_difference": differences,
            "within_limit": all(value <= LIMIT for value in differences.values()),
            "active_ass_events": [{**e, "start": str(e["start"]), "end": str(e["end"])}
                                  for e in events if e["start"] <= actual_time < e["end"]],
            "source_png": str(source.relative_to(ROOT)), "source_png_sha256": digest(source),
            "actual_png": str(actual.relative_to(ROOT)), "actual_png_sha256": digest(actual),
            "expected_png": str(expected.relative_to(ROOT)), "expected_png_sha256": digest(expected),
            "extract_command": extract_command, "overlay_command": overlay_command,
        }

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        results = list(pool.map(check, samples))
    drift = [path for path, identity in original_identities.items() if digest(ROOT / path) != identity]
    failures = [sample for sample in results if not sample["within_limit"]]
    maxima = {key: max(s["mean_absolute_rgb_difference"][key] for s in results)
              for key in results[0]["mean_absolute_rgb_difference"]}
    receipt = {
        "status": "passed" if not failures and not drift else "failed",
        "completed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "mp4_sha256": digest(MEDIA), "ass_sha256": digest(ASS),
        "source_manifest_sha256_at_completion": digest(MANIFEST),
        "scene_count": len(scenes), "chapter_count": len(manifest["chapters"]), "sample_count": len(results),
        "frame_time_rule": "ceil(requested_scene_midpoint * 10) / 10; chapter start + 0.2",
        "timestamp_evidence": "ffmpeg showinfo first-frame PTS in both extraction and overlay render",
        "comparison": "RGB mean absolute difference over upper 850 px against uncaptioned scene PNG; bottom 230 px and full frame against PNG with exact-time ASS captions/countdown",
        "limit_mean_absolute_rgb_difference": LIMIT, "max_mean_absolute_rgb_difference": maxima,
        "source_or_media_drift": drift, "failures": [s["name"] for s in failures],
        "samples": results,
        "human_full_playback_review": "not performed; this is deterministic frame/audio verification",
    }
    (OUTPUT / "frame-check.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != "samples"}, indent=2))
    if failures or drift:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
